title: Modern Vilvgaver
description: Replaces the texture of Vilvgaver with a much more modern look!
body:
![vigag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f23a6c9a95dc6fbbdfb1195568467f086f3df0e.png)
## Do you not like how Vilvgaver uses the legacy villager texture?
## 
## what's that? you do? thats too bad.

This pack is a resource pack for [Yellowbross's Extras](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/yellowbrosss-extras) which replaces the texture of Vilvgaver with a much more modern texture.

..that's it.
